limitations: Every positive integer coefficient is required; a finite prefix does not imply RH.
Zero sums use reflected pairing rather than arbitrary absolute reordering.
Current publisher PDF bytes and all original cited book editions were not obtained; matched inputs and independent replacements are documented.

Can stable finite coefficient information be coupled to an independently proved global growth or positivity constraint?
